title: feat: perspective deskew, eq --curve, fx autopan (RSI round 191)
body:
## Summary
- `perspective` — deskew a filmed screen/whiteboard: `--points x0,y0,x1,y1,x2,y2,x3,y3` takes the 4 corners of the skewed quad in the source (TL,TR,BL,BR, px) and `perspective=sense=0` stretches it onto the output rectangle; `--interp linear|cubic`. Out-of-frame points are rejected as input errors.
- `eq --curve "F,G;F,G"` — freehand EQ line through freq,gain points via `firequalizer=gain_entry` (points interpolate — draw a tilt, a smile, a shelf); measured −18dB cut at 2kHz.
- `fx --kind autopan` — `apulsator` L/R autopan sweep (hz 0.4–3.0 by `--strength`); measured ~10dB R-channel swing over a cycle.

Docs synced (SKILL/README×2/CHANGELOG); version → 0.218.0.

## Test plan
- 471 cli + 4 contract + 17 unit tests green on ffmpeg 4.4.8 (CI toolchain)
- New test: perspective output dims preserved + out-of-frame rejection; `eq --curve` cuts the 2kHz band >6dB; `fx autopan` R-channel level sweeps >4dB span across windows
